# web-development-mcp — llms-full.txt

Universal web development operations MCP server (FastMCP >=3.4.4,<4):
React/Vue scaffolding, package management, Vite/TS/Biome config, component
generation, plus a React dashboard and Tauri shell.

## Ports (operations/WEBAPP_PORTS.md)

- 10852 frontend (vite, web_sota)
- 10853 backend (uvicorn web_sota/backend server:app) + MCP HTTP (/mcp)

## Entry points

- MCP stdio/HTTP: `src/web_development_mcp/mcp_server.py` (`main()`),
  transports in `transport.py` (`--stdio` default, `--http`, `--sse` deprecated)
- CLI: `src/web_development_mcp/cli.py`
- Dashboard backend: `web_sota/backend/server.py` (`server:app`)
- Dashboard frontend: `web_sota/src` (API base: `VITE_API_TARGET`, default
  http://127.0.0.1:10853)

## MCP tools (22, see glama.json)

Scaffolding: list_available_frameworks, create_react_app
(project_name, target_directory, options), create_vue_app (same shape).
SvelteKit/Next.js scaffolds are NOT implemented — never advertise them.
Packages: detect_package_manager, install_packages, update_packages
(check_only=True is read-only), remove_packages (DESTRUCTIVE),
analyze_package_json (read-only).
Build: configure_typescript, configure_biome, configure_vite
(pass the project's own port, never another repo's), setup_testing_config.
Components: generate_react_component, generate_vue_component
(composition_api=True only), generate_custom_hook
(state|effect|fetch|storage only), setup_tailwind, setup_shadcn,
scaffold_dashboard.
Agentic: agentic_workflow_tool (deterministic planner, mode=plan, executes
nothing), toggle_safety_guard (session state), shutdown_server (graceful
exit, destructive).
Meta: get_help (category scaffolding|package|build|component|sampling).

Tool conventions: Annotated[..., Field(description=...)] params (no Args:
blocks), `## Return Format` + `## Examples` docstrings, dialogic returns
{success, message, ...}, annotations readonly/mutating/destructive.

## REST endpoints (webapp backend)

GET /health, /api/health, /api/status, /api/capabilities, /api/metrics,
/api/skills (file-backed from skills/*/SKILL.md), /api/logs (+/stats,
/export, DELETE), /api/llm/discover (live TCP probe :11434/:1234),
/api/llm/providers, /api/llm/models, /api/llm/onboarding,
POST /api/llm/chat (+/stream, Ollama proxy, honest 503 without LLM),
GET /api/v1/diagnostics, POST /api/shutdown (200 now, exit +500ms).

## Env vars (see .env.example)

MCP_TRANSPORT/HOST/PORT/PATH, MCP_BRIDGE_URLS, WEB_PORT, VITE_PORT,
WEB_FRONTEND_PORT, OPENAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (server-side only),
WEB_DEVELOPMENT_EXECUTABLE.

## Session files

.cursorrules + .windsurfrules (## Session Context), .github/copilot-instructions.md,
.claude-plugin/plugin.json + hooks/hooks.json, skills/webdev-expert/SKILL.md
(chat preprompt source). Recipes: just serve|lint|fix|fmt|test|certify|e2e.
